text_block_list.name: Gal-ish Umamusume A
text_block_list.text:
"—Gahaha, that's seriously hilarious~!! 
Let's just eat right here. If we sit down, 
we're good to go."

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text:
"Alright, hold it right there. This is a 
delinquent squatting-free zone. 
Please have some consi... wait, no. 
Con-sid-er-a-tion for the people around 
you."

text_block_list.name: Gal-ish Umamusume A
text_block_list.text:
"Ah, sorry... wait, it's Jordan and City. 
What are you guys doing?"

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text:
"We're the Disciplinary Gals! Born to 
protect the public morals of the Summer 
Walk, yay~. 
Please refrain from using such 
ridiculously loud outside voices."

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text:
"Besides, if you wanna sit, there are 
benches over that way. 
That's where you should eat. There are 
flowers and stuff too, so it's probably 
great for pics."

text_block_list.name: Gal-ish Umamusume B
text_block_list.text:
"For real? Sounds awesome! We're heading 
over~ ...Oh, and we'll keep it down! 
We gotcha. Gotta give City some respect! 
Later!"

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text:
"Ooh...! 
As expected of City, people really look up 
to you!"

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text:
"...Nah. Anyway, even though we offered to 
help, is patrolling like this really okay? 
Isn't it way too lax?"

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text:
"Not a problem at all! 
Let's keep up this momentum and protect 
the public morals of the Summer Walk!"

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text:
"Wait, Bamboo-san, are you really fine 
with this? 
Why not go have some fun?"

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text:
"Maintaining discipline is my top 
priority!"

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text: "...Hey, Bamboo-senpai—"

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text:
"Ayy, yooo! Summer's just gettin' started! 
Can everyone turn it up even more~?! 
Par-tay, par-taaaay♪"

text_block_list.name: Party Crowd
text_block_list.text:
"Wooo☆ Gotta hype it up! Vibes on party 
mode! 
Par-tay, par-tay, par-tay, par-tay♪"

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text:
"HEY! Helios, Palmer! Who are those 
people?! 
And this is in the middle of town, not a 
club! Alright, break it up, disperse!"

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text:
"Bam-cham~ Aren't we comrades who pulled 
off that big operation together? 
Let it sliiiide♪ Pretty please?"

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text:
"That was that, and this is this! 
Today we've got a three-person 
Disciplinary Committee, so I'm definitely 
not letting you get away!"

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text:
"Oho? Looks like you're having fun over 
there! Let us join in too! 
We'll show you how real patrolling is 
done☆"

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text:
"Alright then, time for the Disciplinary 
Party Animals to spread our wings♪ 
Here we go~, ready, set, go!"

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text:
――Whoaaaaa~~~!? 
So this... is the ultimate patrol route, 
huh!?

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text:
Yeeees! From up in the sky, you can see 
absolutely eveeerything, right!? 
Over there! And over there, too! That's 
all our turf☆ Wheeee~~~!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
Look, look, Bamboo! It's so gorgeous down 
there! 
Isn't this just the best view ever!?

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text:
Whoa...! You're right, it's amazing...!  
Uwooo...――Hm?

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text:
Ahhh! Look over there, someone's 
littering! 
Palmer, head over there right this second 
pleaseeeee!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
You got it! Hard banking turn~~~~ ...Wait, 
sorry, this ride doesn't do that! 
Let's go pick it up properly later~~!!

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text:
――Here, Bamboo-senpai. This is really 
good. 
The line was pretty short just now, so... 
care for some?

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text:
Thank you! But I'm currently on patrol 
duty. 
You and the others should eat it, City!

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text:
Heeey, Bam-cham~! Red bean buns are for 
cops, right? 
So ice cream is totally for patrols! Or 
something, dunno★

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text:
...See, that's the thing. Senpai, haven't 
you realized yet? 
The real reason I want to give you ice 
cream.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
! ...She's right, Bamboo. Look, we're at a 
resort, right? 
If you're all stiff and vigilant, people 
will get defensive, won't they? And if 
they try to hide stuff, what happens then?

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text:
...Gasp!? They'll break the rules behind 
our backs...!? 
That's unacceptable! Understood, I shall 
partake!

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text:
...Hehe. Let's keep that vibe going until 
nightfall, then. We'll hit all kinds of 
spots, blend in with the crowd every now 
and then... and do our best on patrol, 
okay?

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text:
Yes ma'am! The Disciplinary Gyaru! The 
Disciplinary Party Girl! And the 
Disciplinary Committee Head! 
Our ultimate trio will blitz right through 
this!!

text_block_list.name: Everyone
text_block_list.text: Yaaaay☆

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text:
――Everyone, thank you so much for joining 
me on patrol! 
Thanks to you, we finished safely without 
any issues!

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text:
Yeeeah, good job☆ We got to go to so many 
places! 
It was basically a "did everything we 
wanted" full course! I should be the one 
thanking you~♪

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text:
You too, Bamboo-senpai. The Summer Walk 
was 
a nice way to refresh yourself, wasn't it?

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text:
Yes! We completed the patrol, and best of 
all, Jordan and everyone took the 
initiative to maintain public morals... 
Uwoooogh!

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text:
It became the greatest memory everrr! 
I definitely won't forget this year's 
Summer Walk♪

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text:
...Like, y'know. We gotta head back soon 
anyway, and I was planning on sneaking out 
for some nightlife once Bamboo let her 
guard down, but...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
Seeing such a heartwarming smile made you 
soft? Haha, I get it. Why not, let's just 
chill and chat for the rest of today.

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text:
Whaaat!? You guys are chilling way too 
early! Bamboo, your Summer Walk isn't even 
over yet, y'know? Don't you need more 
memories!?

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text:
Besides, we haven't patrolled this hotel 
yet! Tonight, we check out the hotel, have 
a room party, swim in the pool~... There's 
still so much we can do♪

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text:
I see! Public morals must be upheld in the 
hotel, not just around town, after all. 
...Wait. If we do all that, lights-out 
will――

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text:
Now, now~ First things first... wanna get 
changed? For night par... I mean, for the 
night patrol. You can even borrow some of 
my clothes, y'know?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
Ooh, Dressing Up Bamboo Part 2? Nice, I'm 
going all out this time! 
I played it safe earlier, but... let's try 
an ojou-style party girl look!

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text:
...And with all four troublemakers 
gathered in one place, 
it looks like your job is gonna last well 
into the night, Bamboo-senpai.

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text:
The final big mission of the Summer Walk, 
then! 
Until lights-out――I'll watch over 
everyone's smiles!
